Why buy a digital section toll for Austria online via the ADAC toll portal?
Immediate start of validity
The digital section toll is valid immediately upon purchase.
Authorised online sales partner
The ADAC is an authorised online sales partner of ASFINAG.
No delays or interruptions
No queuing and time wasted at petrol stations and toll stations.
No service and processing fees
You only pay the section toll price and no service fees.
Where are the Pyhrn section toll segments?
The Pyhrn motorway A9 is an important north-south connection in Austria and has two toll segments. The first toll segment of the Pyhrn motorway is between the Spital/Pyhrn junction and the Ardning junction. You cross the almost 5.5 kilometer long Bosruck Tunnel.
The second toll segment is between the St. Michael and Bösebach junction. There you drive through the approximately 8.3 kilometer long Gleinalm tunnel.

How does the digital section toll work on the Pyhrn motorway?
When ordering the Bosruck and/or Gleinalm section toll as toll secgments of the Pyhrn motorway A9 via the ADAC toll portal, the vehicle license plate number is requested and saved.
When passing through the respective toll booths, the electronic license plate recognition takes effect and allows you to pass without stopping.
A green lane marked specifically for section tolls allows for quick, traffic-free passage.

Do I need a vignette besides the section toll when using the Pyhrn motorway?
Yes, because vignettes are required on all Austrian motorways. So if you use the A9 on more than just the two section toll segments, Bosruck (Spital/Pyhrn junction and Ardning junction) and/or Gleinalm (St. Michael and Bösebach junction), then a section toll ticket is not sufficient.
Buy a digital 1-Day or 10-day vignette here
What is the difference between section toll and a vignette?
In Austria a vignette is required for all motorways and expressways. When using certain motorway segments (see list below), a route-dependent toll, the so-called section toll, is charged instead of the vignette. Please note however, that depending on the entrance to the following section toll segments, a valid vignette may also be necessary.
A13 Brenner motorway: The entire A 13 is subject to route tolls
A 10 Tauern Autobahn: Between Flachau and Rennweg (Tauern and Katschberg tunnels)
S 16 Arlberg expressway: Between St. Anton am Arlberg and Langen am Arlberg (Arlberg tunnel)
A 11 Karawanken Autobahn - direction south: Between St. Jakob im Rosental and the state border in the Karawanken Tunnel
A9 Pyhrn motorway:
Bosrucktunnel: Between Spital/Pyhrn and Ardning
Gleinalmtunnel: Between St. Michael and Bösebach
Which section toll segments exist within Austria?
You will need to pay a section toll on the following motorway sections:
A13 Brenner motorway: The entire A13 is subject to a section toll
A 10 Tauern motorway: Between Flachau and Rennweg (Tauern and Katschberg tunnels)
S 16 Arlberg motorway: Between St. Anton am Arlberg and Langen am Arlberg (Arlberg tunnel)
A 11 Karawanken motorway - southbound: Between St. Jakob im Rosental and the national border in the Karawanken tunnel
A9 Pyhrn motorway:
Bosruck Tunnel: Between Spital/Pyhrn and Ardning
Gleinalm Tunnel: Between St. Michael and Übelbach
Depending on where you enter the motorway sections, you will also need a vignette as this is compulsory on all motorways and speedways in Austria.
Why order via the ADAC toll portal?
The advantages of ordering an austrian toll product online (i.e. digital vignette and/or section toll) via the ADAC toll portal are:
-> Official online sales partner of ASFINAG (austrian toll provider)
-> Immediate validity of the toll products (1-Day, 10-Day, Section toll)
-> Free of charge compared to gray market providers
-> 24/7 availability
-> No queuing and therefore no loss of time (e.g. when buying at gas stations)
How can I change the license plate number for the digital section toll?
You can change the license plate number for which you purchased the digital section toll free of charge, as long as the first trip/ticket has not yet been used or redeemed.
Changes can be made by yourself via our Manage Order area. Please have the order number and the email address you used when ordering ready.
-> Manage order
How can I cancel my digital section toll?
The digital section toll can be cancelled free of charge within 14 days of the booking date if the booked trip/ticket has not yet been used or redeemed.
Please note that if you book two section toll trips/tickets, you can only cancel both trips at once.
Cancellations can be handled by yourself in our Manage Order area.
-> Manage Order
Buy 1-Day and 10-Day vignettes for Austria online
10-Day Vignette Austria
The digital 10-Day Vignette with immediate validity allows you to drive on toll-compulsory motorways and speedways in Austria. The validity period of the 10-day Vignette begins on the 1st day of validity plus 9 additional calendar days. The 10-day Vignette costs € 12.80 for cars (incl. trailers) and € 5.10 for motorbikes.
Buy a 10-Day vignette for Austria online
1-Day Vignette Austria
A new vignette is now available in Austria: the digital 1-Day vignette (Daily vignette). It is valid for one calendar day from 00:00 a.m. - 11:59 p.m.. The 1-Day Vignette is available in the ADAC toll portal. The cost for a 1-Day Vignette for cars and motor vehicles up to and including 3.5 tonnes is €9.10 and €3.80 for motorcycles.
